articles.title: DNO Bidco’s cash offer for Capricorn Energy lapses after deadline miss
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Norway’s DNO said on Monday its cash offer for British oil and gas producer Capricorn Energy had lapsed after conditions for the deal were not met by a Nov. 7 deadline.

articles.title: Genel Energy Raises Capricorn Bid to $436 Million in Takeover Battle
articles.summary: Genel Energy has raised its recommended offer for Capricorn Energy to $5.74 per share, valuing the company at about $436 million and prompting Capricorn’s board to withdraw its recommendation of DNO’s competing bid.

articles.title: Capricorn Energy soars to 15-year high as Genel outbids DNO in takeover battle
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Capricorn Energy soared to their highest level since August 2011 on Friday after Genel Energy raised its cash offer to $436 million, outbidding rival DNO and winning renewed backing from Capricorn’s board.
